title: Manyhands JSON v1 documents or tickets

complete.description: False when the last refresh could not read, or stopped part of the way through, a directory that holds items of this kind: docs or a directory under it for documents, .manyhands/tickets or .manyhands for tickets and for every relationship read, and .manyhands/worktrees, where item worktrees are, for all of them. Items may then be missing while index.state is current.
